item.title: Formation‐Stage Interfacial Regulation of δ‐MnO 2 Enables Stable and Reversible Aqueous Zn‐Ion Storage
item.description:

Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in a formation-stage Fe interfacial regulation strategy that avoids bulk substitution, instead creating low-content, highly dispersed surface/interface Fe species that tune the local Mn─O environment and nanosheet growth. This improves Zn2+ kinetics and suppresses Mn dissolution while preserving Mn redox chemistry, enabling high capacity (409.29 mAh g−1) and durable cycling (81.1% retention after 3000 cycles), offering a design route for stable Mn-based aqueous Zn-ion cathodes.
🏷 aqueous zinc-ion battery · delta-MnO2 cathode · Fe interfacial regulation · Mn dissolution · cycling stability

Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in revealing that Zr in LiNiO₂ predominantly enriches at primary particle surfaces under oxygen-rich conditions, while oxygen-deficient synthesis stabilizes a cation-disordered Li₁₋ₓNi₁₊ₓO₂ phase promoting grain elongation. Significance: only 1–3% Zr suffices to boost cyclability via surface enrichment and low bulk doping, whereas excess Zr forms insulating Li₂ZrO₃, reducing capacity—guiding optimal doping design.
🏷 lithium nickel oxide · Zr doping · surface substitution · cathode · cation ordering

item.title: Weak‑Solvation‑Mediated Localized High‑Concentration Electrolyte for Sodium Metal Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in using fluorine-free methyl tert-butyl ether as a weakly coordinating diluent in THF/NaFSI to create a localized high-concentration electrolyte that shifts solvation from solvent-separated ion pairs to contact ion pairs/aggregates. This weak-solvation design accelerates desolvation, forms an inorganic-rich interphase, and enables fast-charging, dendrite-free sodium metal batteries with high-loading cathodes and PFAS-free sustainability.
🏷 sodium metal battery · localized high-concentration electrolyte · weak solvation · MTBE diluent · solid electrolyte interphase

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in defining a critical Li-plating areal capacity (qLi) via dynamic electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, enabling operando quantification of Li plating validated by ssNMR, incremental capacity analysis, and mass spectrometry titration. Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in directly showing that oxidized oxygen species in a nominally stable superstructure continuously evolve during cycling—from O₂⁻ electron holes and (O₂)ⁿ⁻ dimers to molecular O₂—coupled with Li-vacancy cluster expansion and Mn-domain growth. This establishes molecular O₂ as the inevitable ultimate oxygen-redox product, even when Mn migration is restricted, resolving a key controversy in anionic redox cathodes.

item.title: Sustainable synthesis of graphene/Mn3O4 nanocomposites by direct reuse of Hummers-derived manganese residues for aqueous sodiumion energy storage
item.description:

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in directly reusing Hummers-derived manganese residues to synthesize rGO/Mn3O4 nanocomposites, avoiding waste and extra precursors. This sustainable route is significant because it valorizes hazardous byproducts, reduces environmental impact, and yields functional nanocomposites for aqueous sodium-ion energy storage, offering a greener, cost-effective alternative for electrode material production.
